review.rationale: The Decision strictly authorizes only one offline preparation and validation cycle for a deterministic five-resource CE-G14 input projection, contingent on a qualifying qwen3.7-max review and remote baseline equality. Inputs are fully bound to the CE-G13 sanitized bundle and five exact resources with hashes and byte counts. Output paths are frozen to eight artifacts. The offline budget prohibits network, model, credential, and external writes. Positive and negative checks, byte caps, cost math, and fail-closed stop conditions are comprehensive. The prior diagnostic hash is correctly treated as non-normative, requiring two independent canonical serializations to agree. All CE-G14 execution, public GET, technical reuse, and commercial/authority effects remain false. Authority boundaries are preserved, and no implicit CE-G14 model sessions or deployment are authorized.
